_comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/verify_route_oracles.mjs. real = genuine street/data geometry (evidence in reason); known-bug = accepted pipeline artifact. Regenerate candidates with --write-whitelist, review in the triage gallery, prune stale entries as fixes land. Rebuilt 2026-07-27 against the BUG set after the shape matcher gained the strand-mean reference, and after that reference showed the WOBBLE residue is genuinely pipeline weave — correcting the blanket real verdicts of PR #36.

entries.reason: WOBBLE {"devM":9.3} — residual pipeline weave, accepted pending further mechanism work. Re-reviewed 2026-07-27 after the shape matcher gained the strand-mean reference: within 80 m of this anchor, NEITHER the digitised strands NOR their mean produce a two-sided weave at all, while the corridor crosses the chord to both sides by more than 3 m. The street bows one way; the corridor waves. This corrects the 'real' verdict recorded on 2026-07-26 in PR #36, which compared max chord deviation only and so missed the two-sidedness that defines the class. Node re-centring (PR #35) cut this class from 25 sites at up to 15.2 m to 10 at up to 11.7 m; what is left is the sawtooth that survives smoothing and simplification.
